title: FAIR-V1 OCC Message Event

event_type.description: occ_rx = timestamp at entry to the FAIR application receive handler after the protocol stack delivers telemetry; occ_tx = timestamp immediately before the FAIR application invokes the protocol-specific echo submission/send operation. Exact API callsites are bound later by protocol source audit.

service_id.description: Must identify the FAIR application-echo service instance recorded in run metadata.

description: Pi-side FAIR application-echo events. Events are generated by the FAIR echo application layer, not by treating broker/protocol-native acknowledgements as FAIR application echoes.
